_comment: PD-SAFE PERF ARM off - 300 s WIRING SMOKE.  NOT A MEASUREMENT.

posture actually PRINTS the run-end readout: the D0 'foldDdPriors: ... M-inverse ...'
line (NetworkTeardown.cpp:238-244) and the INC-0 'folded INERTLY' census.  Both are

*** DO NOT QUOTE fold_minv_ms FROM THIS RUN. *** Measured on the archived smoke pair,
300 s reads +18.6 % where the 3 h arm on the same single knob reads +51.4 %: at 11
epochs the OFF arm has only tripped 16.10 % of the carried dimension vs 85.24 % at
360 epochs, because the giant joint lane block only goes indefinite by ~ep0122.
+18.6 % is ALSO inside the noise floor (ten archived byte-identical 11-epoch runs
spread 641-902 ms, CV 11.9 %).  A 300 s arm manufactures a false PASS.
